sources: Owner-approved Saraswati twin cities plan, 14 November 2026
name: Denu

lines.text: Driftwood out of the middle, roots left at the sides. Come back after rain and you can see why.
The road stays open while the tram runs. Keep to its side and you can watch it pass.
You have looked long enough to see what we were trying to keep. That changes the conversation.
